verdict.rationale: Event-driven automation rules are a fair axis for a transcription API service, but the evidence shows no user-definable rules or triggers. It documents only on-demand transcription modes (fast, live WebSocket, batch over S3 prefixes) and a suggestion to pass transcripts to the Summarizer API. Those are developer building blocks the user would wire together themselves, not a rule-to-action automation capability, so they earn no credit.
